assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an unlettered 3:4 portrait poster background for a Chinese companion app photography feature. A tasteful analogue photo studio editorial aesthetic: warm ivory paper, pale apricot, dusty terracotta, soft peach daylight, transparent amber film strips and a small vintage camera partly outside the bottom left edge, translucent photographic negatives and realistic shadows near the right edge, subtly tactile studio backdrop. Rich depth and soft light but quiet and not extravagant. The upper left headline area and central 75 percent must remain light and empty for later placement of real app screenshots and Chinese typography. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI, phones, screens, faces or people. No purple CD aesthetic, no stars or fantasy.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a fictional demo illustration for a companion app photo studio. Portrait 3:4 image. Two clearly adult East Asian characters in their mid twenties, an adult man with slightly wavy short black hair, dark eyes and an olive green cotton chore jacket over a cream shirt, and an adult woman with a chin-length chestnut bob, brown eyes and a warm ivory cardigan. They are standing close at a small sunlit bookshop window, comfortable and quietly amused, looking at each other. Show faces clearly in three-quarter view, waist-up, both hands naturally placed, fully clothed. Sophisticated painterly anime and colored-pencil editorial illustration, expressive individual faces, luminous warm autumn afternoon, detailed window light, tactile textured colors, cinematic depth and restrained composition. This is an illustration, no photorealistic or real human faces. No text, lettering, logos, frame, collage, phone or app interface. The two adults are fictional demonstration characters.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a fictional 2 by 2 photo booth illustration, exactly four equally sized square panels with a thick straight pure white cross-shaped gutter and no other frame. Keep the same TWO clearly adult fictional characters, faces, short black wavy hair for the man and chestnut bob for the woman, olive chore jacket and cream shirt for him and ivory cardigan for her, from the reference illustration. Each panel is a close-up couple picture in the same pale warm photo booth: first both smiling at the viewer, second the adult woman playfully covering the adult man's eyes with one hand, third making a small finger heart together, fourth leaning heads together with amused smiles. Preserve the sophisticated colored-pencil and painterly illustration style; make it clearly illustrated rather than a real human photograph. Four different natural expressions, faces clearly visible except the playful eye-cover panel, anatomical hands. No text, stickers, labels, numbers, logos, interface or extra panels. Square overall image.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a fictional photo diary illustration of the SAME clearly adult black-haired man from the reference, without the woman. Exactly THREE equally sized landscape panels stacked vertically in one portrait image, each scene separated by a straight thick pure white horizontal gutter. Top panel: late morning at a sunlit book restoration workbench, the adult man wears the olive green cotton chore jacket over a cream shirt, repairing an old book, his three-quarter face clearly visible. Middle panel: afternoon in a cafe at the window, jacket removed, wearing only the cream shirt, seated with a mug and an open book, a different camera angle and his face visible. Bottom panel: evening at home, wearing a rust-brown knit cardigan over the cream shirt, reading in a chair near a warm desk lamp, awake with a gentle half smile, not sleeping, a different eye-level camera angle. Preserve his fictional facial identity, short wavy black hair, sophisticated painterly colored-pencil illustration and rich cinematic light. Clearly illustrated, no real human photographs. Exactly three panels and no extra frames, no film border, no text, letters, clock labels, captions, logos or interface. Portrait overall composition.
